### Praneel Mahalatkar — Histogram of body weight of Adelie penguins

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
penguins |>
  filter(species == 'Adelie') |>
    ggplot(aes(body_mass_g)) +
        geom_histogram(fill = 'steelblue', bins= 40) +
          theme_classic() +
            labs(
              title = 'Distribution of Body Weight of Adelie Penguins',
              x = 'Body Mass (g)',
              y = 'Count'
            )
```
